messages.content: Can you briefly explain what JSONL is and when people use it?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise explanation of JSONL. This is a straightforward informational question that does not require any tools.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>JSONL is a text format where each line is a separate, valid JSON object. It is commonly used for streaming data and machine-learning datasets because you can read or write one record at a time without parsing the entire file into memory.</content>
</action>
